definitions.explanation: The time of day just before nightfall when the sun is setting and the sky darkens.

examples.japanese: {夕暮|ゆうぐ}れが{近|ちか}づいてきた。
{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れの{空|そら}が{美|うつく}しい。
{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ{時|どき}に{散歩|さんぽ}するのが{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: I like taking walks at dusk.

notes:
USAGE:
{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ{時|どき} is a common compound meaning "at twilight/dusk."

RELATED TIME EXPRESSIONS:
・{夕方|ゆうがた} - evening (broader term, more commonly used)
・{日暮|ひぐ}れ - sunset, nightfall
・{黄昏|たそがれ} - twilight (more literary)
・{暁|あかつき} - dawn (opposite time)

NUANCE:
{夕暮|ゆうぐ}れ has a poetic, atmospheric quality often associated with nostalgia or melancholy in Japanese literature and art.
